ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with a macro-ratio of approximately 45% low-intensity (black) central/leading-edge pixels to 55% high-intensity (white) medial-lobe pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central low-intensity block extending from the peduncle to the trailing edge; flanking high-intensity fields occupying the mid-section of both lobes; low-intensity mottling and speckling observed at the distal tips and along the anterior margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped notch with an obtuse pixel angle of approximately 130 degrees and a defined vertical indentation depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated profile along the entire trailing boundary; high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys most prominent on the distal thirds of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the central notch, transitioning into a linear sweep toward tapered, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters localized within the central dark pigmentation zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical linear pixel disruptions observed in the dark pigmentation near the peduncle attachment point, distinct from natural color transitions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular white focal scarring present in the dark central region; micro-irregularities along the trailing edge consistent with accumulated minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of non-biological high-contrast alphanumeric identifiers 'HWC #7249' and 'YoNAH #1356' at the bottom of the image frame.
